Reference

Where the material goes

A statistical look at the Fantomon ability trees: what each page returns per material, how fast the returns fall, what focusing on the formation buys against spreading, the exact order that maximises power per material, and a calculator for your own stock. Numbers are the Mythic DPS tree at Fantomon level 150 unless a control says otherwise; the other roles and qualities scale every figure by a constant and keep the same order.

The model

Power is the game's combat rating: each stat times its weight from prop_cfg (ATK 2.5, DEF 2.5, SPD 3.125, HP 0.5). A percent node multiplies the Fantomon's own stat before scoring, so its worth grows with the Fantomon's level. The Fantomon's whole stat set is then scaled by where it sits: the main slot counts 1, each side slot 0.5, and every idle Fantomon 0.2 (from game_settings). Material is counted in the family's base unit, four of a tier making one of the next. Crit, accuracy and damage nodes score against your own base stats and are excluded; they sit on every page alike and do not change any ranking below.

Purrwikimania — an independent, fan-made reference for Sword x Staff (Boltray Games). Every number here is read directly out of the game's own configuration files and decompiled code, not from testing or estimation. Item names are the game's official English strings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Boltray Games. Game names, images and data are the property of their owners. Figures reflect the client build they were extracted from and can change with any patch — see Method for exactly what was read and when.
